## Verification

List any additional manual or authenticated checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Source quotations and anchors remain exact.
- [ ] Interpretations are labeled and unsupported claims are bounded.
- [ ] No credential, private source, backup, or generated media was committed.
- [ ] New persistence or import data is covered by a Zod contract and migration.
- [ ] New provider traffic is disclosed before data leaves the browser.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the final behavior.
